title: Cough
summary: Loosen phlegm and soothe the throat
ayurvedicView: A wet cough with phlegm is linked to excess Kapha, a dry, tickly cough to Vata. Warm, moist remedies and rest help the body clear it.
remedies: Half a teaspoon of honey with a pinch of pippali or black pepper, two to three times a day (no honey for children under one)
Mulethi (licorice) tea for a dry cough, for a few days only
Vasaka syrup, if a practitioner advises
Steam inhalation with a teaspoon of ajwain seeds
Warm water and warm soups through the day
prevention: Wash hands often and cover coughs
Avoid smoke, dust and incense smoke
tips: Sip warm fluids rather than cold drinks
Sleep with your head slightly raised
seeDoctor: A cough lasting more than three weeks, or with weight loss or night sweats
High fever, or a child who is struggling to breathe
